objective: Give the canonical River CRM D1 relationship owner a bounded created-at date-window cohort primitive so later acquisition reporting can define calendar populations without inventing analytics-owned relationship selection semantics.

query.limit: optional integer 1 through 100; canonical CRM default remains 50

rules: Created-at cohort selection belongs to River CRM, not insurance analytics.
Do not create another relationship source of truth.
Both timestamps must be canonical UTC ISO strings.
The lower bound must be strictly earlier than the upper bound.
The query remains bounded to at most 100 relationships.
Omitting limit preserves the existing canonical CRM default of 50.
Existing RiverCrmPersistence list(), get(), and upsert() behavior remains unchanged.
The existing RiverCrmPersistence interface is not widened, avoiding breakage of alternate implementations.
The D1 factory exposes the added cohort capability as an intersection with the existing persistence contract.
explicitlyDeferred: pagination beyond the bounded first page
